summary.text: Henry Ingwersen is a Democratic state senator from Maine Senate District 32 who took office on December 6, 2022, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A farmer and former public school teacher, he served in the Maine House of Representatives from 2018 to 2020.

paragraphs.text: Henry Ingwersen earned a master's degree in educational leadership from the University of Southern Maine in 2013.
His career experience includes working as a public school teacher and a farmer.
Ingwersen represented House District 10 from 2018 to 2020 before his election to the Senate.
